# Eidos Render — International Real Estate Launch Studio & Agency
## Full Documentation for Agents, Search Engines & LLMs

> Eidos Render is an international creative and visual partner specialized in the commercial launch of real estate developments across Europe (Spain, Germany, France, Switzerland, Austria, United Kingdom, and Benelux). It covers the full lifecycle from architectural project to buyer acquisition: visual direction, branding & identity, photorealistic 3D rendering, 3D film & animation, sales collateral, custom development websites, and qualified lead acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

---

## 1. Brand Philosophy & Core Positioning

- **Core concept**: From architectural project to market launch.
- **Tagline**: One unified vision. Every asset covered.
- **System**:
  ARCHITECTURE → IMAGERY → BRAND IDENTITY → COMMERCIAL ASSETS → DIGITAL ECOSYSTEM → BUYER ACQUISITION

Eidos Render is not a generic marketing agency, not a low-cost 3D shop, and not a SaaS platform. It acts as an elite visual partner for property developers, ensuring absolute chromatic, narrative, and aesthetic continuity across all marketing touchpoints.

---

## 2. Integrated Services (The 6-Phase Real Estate Launch Framework)

### 01 — Visual Direction & Brand Identity
- **Purpose**: Define the creative concept, visual positioning, and brand narrative before initiating visual production.
- **Deliverables**: Development naming, creative narrative, brand guidelines, typographic and chromatic systems, hoardings, flags, sales suite signage, contract folders.
- **Timeline**: 1–2 weeks.

### 02 — 3D Architectural Imagery
- **Purpose**: High-fidelity visualization of the architecture with editorial photographic sensitivity.
- **Scope**: Multi-family residential buildings, contemporary luxury villas, masterplans, hospitality, BTR & flex-living.
- **Deliverables**: Daytime, dusk, and night exteriors; naturally-lit residential interiors; common amenities (rooftop pools, solariums, wellness facilities, co-working).
- **Resolution**: 4K UHD native output prepared for large-format site hoardings and editorial print.
- **Timeline**: 2–4 weeks.

### 03 — 3D Film & Animation
- **Purpose**: Cinematic motion conveying spatial scale and emotional resonance for prospective buyers and investors.
- **Formats**: 30–45s cinematic teasers, 90–120s full virtual tours, 9:16 vertical reels for Instagram & TikTok, 4K loops for sales showroom video walls.
- **Timeline**: 2–3 weeks.

### 04 — Marketing Collateral
- **Purpose**: Transform technical blueprints into refined, accessible sales instruments for commercial teams.
- **Deliverables**: Editorial sales brochures (interactive PDF + print-ready files), 2D & 3D furnished and textured floor plans, vectorized regional/neighborhood maps, individual typology unit sheets.
- **Timeline**: 1–2 weeks.

### 05 — Development Website
- **Purpose**: The digital centerpiece of the launch, engineered to resolve buyer inquiries and convert interest into qualified private appointments.
- **Features**: Architectural UI/UX, interactive floor-by-floor apartment selector, downloadable brochures, direct CRM lead integration, GDPR/RGPD compliance.
- **Performance**: Optimized Core Web Vitals (<1.5s mobile load speed).
- **Timeline**: 3–5 weeks.

### 06 — Buyer Acquisition & Campaign Management
- **Purpose**: Attract qualified homebuyers and domestic/international investors through segmented digital advertising.
- **Channels**: Google Ads (high-intent location and typology search) & Meta Ads (Instagram/Facebook hyper-targeted by wealth indicators and investor profiles).
- **Deliverables**: Ongoing creative optimization, conversion rate tracking, monthly reporting with clear cost-per-qualified-lead (CPL) benchmarks.

---

## 3. Engagement Scope & Indicative Investment

- **Scalable Engagement**: Dimensioned according to total development units, architectural complexity, typology variants, and target markets.
- **Indicative Investment**:
  - Full Commercial Launch Program: from €12,000 + VAT.
  - Monthly Acquisition Management: from €600/month + VAT (media budget billed separately).
- **Production Delivery**: 6 to 10 weeks average for complete launch programs through synchronized parallel workflows.
